---
title: Meet the Team
---

The SI was in formed June 2023 by NOAA Fisheries’ Science Board and includes scientists from [NOAA Fisheries Science Centers](https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/contact-directory/science-centers) around the country including Northeast (NEFSC), Southeast (SEFSC), Southwest (SWFSC), Northwest (NWFSC), Alaska (AFSC),  Pacific Islands (PIFSC), and NOAA’s Office of Science and Technology (OST). In July 2026 there was a change in the leadership of the SI, and its membership was revisited and expanded.  *Denotes new member brought on in 2026.
